architectureDecisions.decision: Timeline IR remains the only source of truth; projection and journal are derived control artifacts.
Integer ticks and rational frame rates are canonical; legacy seconds remain a validated compatibility representation.
Every editor mutation is allowlisted, base-hash protected, journaled and followed by explicit QC requirements.
Studio Canvas is approximate only and FFmpeg Render Graph remains the canonical final renderer.
WebGPU remains not_implemented until a real runtime and current parity evidence exist.

acceptance: Fractional and integer frame rates round-trip exactly at frame boundaries
Legacy Timeline migration writes a new canonical file
Conflicting seconds and ticks fail closed
Projection exposes typed tracks stable unique item IDs and source pointers
Only explicit per-item fields are editable
Invalid timing and out-of-canvas geometry fail closed
Apply undo and redo are atomic and hash protected
Journal digest-chain tamper and truncation are detected
External drift duplicate IDs and duplicate commands fail closed
CLI and Studio share the same editor kernel
Browser sessions bind one Timeline and expire
Forged sessions cannot select arbitrary write paths
Workbench opens a Timeline and renders source projection tracks and Inspector
Apply undo and redo complete in a real browser
Empty loading error desktop and narrow layouts remain legible with no console errors
Approximate preview is visibly labeled
Unknown approximate and unimplemented providers cannot produce final
FFmpeg remains the only current final-eligible provider
Focused and full regressions pass
Static secret installer and diff gates pass
Product documentation and Codex Claude installs reflect the implementation
